ba9a6655-740f-4b0f-9654-784ea91dab4c.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
ba9a6655-740f-4b0f-9654-784ea91dab4c.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

blueprint.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries

tech_stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
tech_stack.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
tech_stack.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq

architecture.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)

development_tasks.title: Initialize Project Repository and Environment
development_tasks.description: Set up monorepo/folder structure, Docker Compose for local PostgreSQL+pgvector and Redis, and linting/formatting configs.

development_tasks.title: Build Document Upload & Storage Pipeline
development_tasks.description: Implement FastAPI multipart file upload endpoints with MIME validation, secure hashing, and local/S3 storage integration.

development_tasks.title: Implement Tamil OCR Extraction Pipeline
development_tasks.description: Configure Tesseract Tamil language models, preprocess scanned images (contrast adjustment, deskewing), and extract text with confidence scoring.

development_tasks.title: Vector Chunking & Embedding Service
development_tasks.description: Design Tamil-aware text chunking with sentence overlap, generate multilingual embeddings, and upsert vectors into pgvector.

development_tasks.title: Implement RAG Query & Citation Engine
development_tasks.description: Build similarity search pipeline with prompt formatting, grounding constraints, and source attribution references.

development_tasks.title: Develop React Document & Chat UI
development_tasks.description: Create document upload dropzone, PDF viewer with highlighted citations, and interactive conversational query interface.

development_tasks.title: End-to-End Testing & OCR Accuracy Evaluation
development_tasks.description: Write integration tests covering document ingestion to question answering with sample Tamil test documents.

next_steps: Review and approve the recommended technology stack and component boundaries.
Initialize the Git repository and local developer environment using Docker Compose.
Validate OCR/AI model latency and accuracy with representative sample data.
Implement Phase 1 core ingestion and API endpoints before expanding UI features.

55e13a33-a802-4fd3-9869-d6aa01798e73.name: Fleet Route Optimization Platform
55e13a33-a802-4fd3-9869-d6aa01798e73.idea: Real-time GPS routing and battery optimization service for electric delivery vans.

blueprint.summary: Fleet Route Optimization Platform is a real-time fleet telematics and route optimization system designed for delivery operations. It aggregates live vehicle GPS telemetry, analyzes battery consumption and topography, computes dynamic multi-stop routes, and surfaces driver dispatch metrics through a responsive web and mobile operations console.
requirements: High-throughput ingestion of real-time GPS coordinates and battery state-of-charge (SoC) telemetry
Dynamic routing engine considering vehicle battery range, traffic conditions, and delivery windows
Live map visualization of fleet vehicles with real-time status updates and speed alerts
Automated charging stop scheduling based on charging station availability and pricing
Driver dispatch mobile-friendly dashboard for delivery confirmation and incident reporting
REST and WebSocket APIs for enterprise ERP/WMS integration

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js + React Leaflet / Mapbox GL + Tailwind CSS
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI + WebSockets + Celery for async route calculation
tech_stack.database: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL time-series) + Redis Geo + MinIO for exports
tech_stack.ai: OR-Tools / OSRM routing solver + LightGBM battery degradation estimator

architecture.description: Telemetry data is ingested through high-speed WebSocket and REST endpoints into TimescaleDB. A route optimization engine processes order queues and battery levels, dispatching optimized navigation routes to driver interfaces while broadcasting real-time location changes to the operations map.

blueprint.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries

tech_stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
tech_stack.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
tech_stack.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq

architecture.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)

0041dbbc-8483-4b24-97d4-531aa0775e63.name: Fleet Route Optimization Platform
0041dbbc-8483-4b24-97d4-531aa0775e63.idea: Real-time GPS routing and battery optimization service for electric delivery vans.

output.summary: Fleet Route Optimization Platform is a real-time fleet telematics and route optimization system designed for delivery operations. It aggregates live vehicle GPS telemetry, analyzes battery consumption and topography, computes dynamic multi-stop routes, and surfaces driver dispatch metrics through a responsive web and mobile operations console.
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: High-throughput ingestion of real-time GPS coordinates and battery state-of-charge (SoC) telemetry
Dynamic routing engine considering vehicle battery range, traffic conditions, and delivery windows
Live map visualization of fleet vehicles with real-time status updates and speed alerts
Automated charging stop scheduling based on charging station availability and pricing
Driver dispatch mobile-friendly dashboard for delivery confirmation and incident reporting
REST and WebSocket APIs for enterprise ERP/WMS integration
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: Telemetry data is ingested through high-speed WebSocket and REST endpoints into TimescaleDB. A route optimization engine processes order queues and battery levels, dispatching optimized navigation routes to driver interfaces while broadcasting real-time location changes to the operations map.
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: Next.js + React Leaflet / Mapbox GL + Tailwind CSS
output.backend: FastAPI + WebSockets + Celery for async route calculation
output.database: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL time-series) + Redis Geo + MinIO for exports
output.ai: OR-Tools / OSRM routing solver + LightGBM battery degradation estimator
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

cb2707c5-3d89-4a79-b651-763ed4ed5fca.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
cb2707c5-3d89-4a79-b651-763ed4ed5fca.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

requirements.name: requirements
requirements.label: Requirements Engineering

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
Custom user requirement: Must support offline batch processing of 10,000 documents
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

requirements.guidance: Must support offline batch processing of 10,000 documents

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in SQLite vector extension. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI + Python 3.12
output.database: SQLite 3 with vector extension (Local Edge)
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

requirements.name: requirements
requirements.label: Requirements Engineering

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces

When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.

output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.database: SQLite 3 with vector extension (Local Edge)
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

36be6dc3-dec4-484b-b55a-9b5b7b18c520.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
36be6dc3-dec4-484b-b55a-9b5b7b18c520.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

requirements.name: requirements
requirements.label: Requirements Engineering

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
Custom user requirement: Must support offline batch processing of 10,000 documents
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

requirements.guidance: Must support offline batch processing of 10,000 documents

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in SQLite vector extension. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI + Python 3.12
output.database: SQLite 3 with vector extension (Local Edge)
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files

Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching

import os
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/documents", tags=["documents"])

UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads")
UPLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES = {"application/pdf", "image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/tiff"}

class UploadResponse(BaseModel):
    filename: str
    file_id: str
    size_bytes: int
    content_type: str
    status: str

@router.post("/upload", response_model=UploadResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def upload_document(file: UploadFile = File(...)):
    """Receives and securely stores a document for processing."""
    if file.content_type not in ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_415_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,
            detail=f"Unsupported file format: {file.content_type}. Allowed: {ALLOWED_MIME_TYPES}"
        )

    content = await file.read()
    file_hash = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
    safe_filename = f"{file_hash}_{file.filename}"
    target_path = UPLOAD_DIR / safe_filename

    with open(target_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(content)

    return UploadResponse(
        filename=file.filename or "unknown",
        file_id=file_hash,
        size_bytes=len(content),
        content_type=file.content_type or "application/octet-stream",
        status="uploaded"
    )

from fastapi import FastAPI
from .routes.documents import router as documents_router
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware

app = FastAPI(
    title="Tamil AI Document Intelligence API",
    description="Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Note: add more tech stack",
    version="0.1.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

@app.get("/api/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Tamil AI Document Intelligence"}

@app.get("/api/info")
async def info():
    return {
        "name": "Tamil AI Document Intelligence",
        "architecture": "The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user."
    }


# Mount Documents Ingestion Route
app.include_router(documents_router)

requirements.name: requirements

73ad86e0-12a9-4c49-ac96-4d7fea5f0b5d.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.

1de2f1c2-a8ef-403e-9d95-6f6102a4218d.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
1de2f1c2-a8ef-403e-9d95-6f6102a4218d.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

9923db4a-6e2d-4240-8fa3-1ce2ad00d491.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
9923db4a-6e2d-4240-8fa3-1ce2ad00d491.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

blueprint.summary: Tamil Document AI Suite is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries

tech_stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
tech_stack.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
tech_stack.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq

architecture.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)

903356a1-fe04-49a4-93b7-79b738f891f2.name: Fleet Route Optimization Platform
903356a1-fe04-49a4-93b7-79b738f891f2.idea: Real-time GPS routing and battery optimization service for electric delivery vans.

output.summary: Fleet Route Optimization Platform is a real-time fleet telematics and route optimization system designed for delivery operations. It aggregates live vehicle GPS telemetry, analyzes battery consumption and topography, computes dynamic multi-stop routes, and surfaces driver dispatch metrics through a responsive web and mobile operations console.
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: High-throughput ingestion of real-time GPS coordinates and battery state-of-charge (SoC) telemetry
Dynamic routing engine considering vehicle battery range, traffic conditions, and delivery windows
Live map visualization of fleet vehicles with real-time status updates and speed alerts
Automated charging stop scheduling based on charging station availability and pricing
Driver dispatch mobile-friendly dashboard for delivery confirmation and incident reporting
REST and WebSocket APIs for enterprise ERP/WMS integration
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: Telemetry data is ingested through high-speed WebSocket and REST endpoints into TimescaleDB. A route optimization engine processes order queues and battery levels, dispatching optimized navigation routes to driver interfaces while broadcasting real-time location changes to the operations map.

output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

8b329e08-5d7c-4e31-8145-3cb228292bd3.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
8b329e08-5d7c-4e31-8145-3cb228292bd3.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

d2cfae9b-74e8-4409-80a2-35f2af1a06b8.idea: Real-time GPS routing and battery optimization service for electric delivery vans.

output.summary: Fleet Route Optimization Platform is a real-time fleet telematics and route optimization system designed for delivery operations. It aggregates live vehicle GPS telemetry, analyzes battery consumption and topography, computes dynamic multi-stop routes, and surfaces driver dispatch metrics through a responsive web and mobile operations console.
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: High-throughput ingestion of real-time GPS coordinates and battery state-of-charge (SoC) telemetry
Dynamic routing engine considering vehicle battery range, traffic conditions, and delivery windows
Live map visualization of fleet vehicles with real-time status updates and speed alerts
Automated charging stop scheduling based on charging station availability and pricing
Driver dispatch mobile-friendly dashboard for delivery confirmation and incident reporting
REST and WebSocket APIs for enterprise ERP/WMS integration
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: Telemetry data is ingested through high-speed WebSocket and REST endpoints into TimescaleDB. A route optimization engine processes order queues and battery levels, dispatching optimized navigation routes to driver interfaces while broadcasting real-time location changes to the operations map.
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.database: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL time-series) + Redis Geo + MinIO for exports

Dynamic routing engine considering vehicle battery range, traffic conditions, and delivery windows
Live map visualization of fleet vehicles with real-time status updates and speed alerts
Automated charging stop scheduling based on charging station availability and pricing
Driver dispatch mobile-friendly dashboard for delivery confirmation and incident reporting
REST and WebSocket APIs for enterprise ERP/WMS integration

ff97d649-360c-4ebf-8068-a11480c1dd68.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
ff97d649-360c-4ebf-8068-a11480c1dd68.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

53fdcbd5-6a16-4082-a36d-41855bb2042a.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
53fdcbd5-6a16-4082-a36d-41855bb2042a.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.

0a1d07f1-15ce-4305-8d21-c9a7a00de322.name: Tamil AI Document Intelligence
0a1d07f1-15ce-4305-8d21-c9a7a00de322.idea: Build an AI system that allows users to upload Tamil documents, extract text using OCR, search the documents using RAG, and ask questions about the uploaded content.

output.summary: Tamil AI Document Intelligence is an intelligent Tamil-language document processing and retrieval platform. It ingests scanned documents and PDFs, extracts high-accuracy Tamil and English text using specialized OCR, indexes textual chunks into a semantic vector store, and enables users to perform natural language question answering grounded directly in document context via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
key_challenges: Data ingestion throughput and format normalization
Latency management under concurrent request volume
Accuracy and precision of domain-specific intelligence models
Secure role-based resource isolation
output.recommended_approach: Decoupled microservice/service-oriented architecture with asynchronous task queue.

functional_requirements: Secure multi-format document ingestion pipeline supporting PDF, PNG, JPEG, and TIFF files
High-accuracy Tamil and bilingual OCR extraction with skew correction and layout preservation
Automated text chunking, tokenization, and language-specific metadata tagging
Vector embedding generation utilizing multilingual models (e.g. IndicBERT / Multilingual E5)
Conversational RAG interface providing grounded answers with source page and paragraph citations
Role-based access control (RBAC) ensuring document privacy across user workspaces
Audit logs and export functionality for extracted text and generated question-answer summaries
non_functional_requirements: Sub-second API response latency for 95% of standard requests
Strict input sanitization, rate limiting, and CORS governance
Containerized deployments with health checks and graceful teardown
Full audit trail logging for security compliance

output.description: The system follows a decoupled, event-driven architecture. The React single-page frontend communicates with the FastAPI gateway via REST and Server-Sent Events. Ingested documents are stored in object storage, while an asynchronous OCR worker pool extracts text and coordinates. Extracted text chunks are vectorized and indexed in pgvector. When a query is submitted, the RAG engine performs hybrid dense-sparse semantic retrieval and streams context-grounded responses back to the user.
components: Vector Store & Hybrid Retrieval Engine (pgvector / Qdrant)
output.communication_protocol: REST over HTTP/2, WebSockets for streaming events
output.caching_strategy: Redis in-memory caching for active sessions and frequent queries

output.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
output.backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+) + Uvicorn + Pydantic v2 + Celery worker queue
output.database: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (or Qdrant) + Redis for task caching
output.ai: Tesseract OCR (Tamil traineddata) / EasyOCR + IndicBERT / BGE-M3 embeddings + Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama or Groq
output.rationale: Chosen for fast developer velocity, high reliability, and rich ecosystem support.
